verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Linux is the native platform for B300 systems: DGX OS 7 is based on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, with additional support for Ubuntu, RHEL 8/9 and Rocky Linux. The pack has no documented Linux driver release notes or versions for the B300 part, and no independent hands-on Linux testing. The community review mention concerns price and power, not Linux. missing for 10: documented Linux driver releases for B300, independent Linux testing or benchmarks of the part.
